#PART 1: Importing and Inspecting a CSV

A1: 
```{r}
emp_df <- read.csv("employees.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
```

A2:

```{r}
str(emp_df)
head(emp_df, 5)
summary(emp_df)

```


A3:

```{r}
nrow(emp_df)
ncol(emp_df)
sapply(emp_df, class)
```


A4:

```{r}
mean(emp_df$salary)
max(emp_df$age)
table(emp_df$department)
```

#PART B: Creating Data Frames


B1:
```{r}
new_hires <- data.frame(
  emp_id = c(21, 22, 23),
  name = c("Uma", "Victor", "Wen"),
  department = c("HR", "IT", "Sales"),
  sex = c("F", "M", "F"),
  age = c(28, 37, 33),
  salary = c(45000, 82000, 60000),
  years_service = c(2, 9, 6),
  rating = c(3, 4, 5),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

```



B2:
```{r}
emp_all <- rbind(emp_df, new_hires)
dim(emp_all)
```



B3:
```{r}
 emp_all$bonus <- round(emp_all$salary * 0.05)
head(emp_all)
```


#PART C: Subsetting

C1:
```{r}
emp_all[1:5, c("name", "salary")]
```

C2:
```{r}
emp_all[emp_all$salary > 70000, ]
```

C3:
```{r}
subset(emp_all, department == "IT" & years_service >= 5, select = c(name, years_service, salary))
```

C4:
```{r}
old_rows <- which(emp_all$age > 50)
print(old_rows)
print(emp_all$name[old_rows])
```

C5:
```{r}
emp_no_cols <- emp_all[, -c(which(names(emp_all) == "emp_id"), which(names(emp_all) == "bonus"))]
head(emp_no_cols, 3)

```

C6:
```{r}
emp_all$salary[emp_all$name == "Mia"]
```

PART D: Factors


D1:
```{r}
emp_all$department <- factor(emp_all$department)
emp_all$sex <- factor(emp_all$sex)
levels(emp_all$department)
levels(emp_all$sex)
```

D2:
```{r}
table(emp_all$department)
table(emp_all$department, emp_all$sex)

```

D3:
```{r}
emp_all$rating_level <- factor(emp_all$rating, levels = 1:5, labels = c("Poor", "Fair", "Good", "Very Good", "Excellent"), ordered = TRUE)
table(emp_all$rating_level)
```

D4:
```{r}
for (dept in levels(emp_all$department)) {
  mean_sal <- mean(emp_all$salary[emp_all$department == dept])
  cat("Department:", dept, "- Mean Salary:", round(mean_sal), "\n")
}
```

#PART E: Conditional Statements



E1:
```{r}
emp_all$salary_band <- ifelse(emp_all$salary >= 70000, "High",
                              ifelse(emp_all$salary >= 50000, "Medium", "Low"))
table(emp_all$salary_band)
```

E2:
```{r}
emp_all$level <- ifelse(emp_all$years_service >= 8, "Senior", "Junior")
table(emp_all$level)
```

E3:
```{r}
raise_pct <- function(rating) {
  if (rating == 5) {
    return(0.10)
  } else if (rating == 4) {
    return(0.07)
  } else if (rating == 3) {
    return(0.04)
  } else {
    return(0)
  }
}
emp_all$raise <- sapply(emp_all$rating, raise_pct)
emp_all$new_salary <- round(emp_all$salary * (1 + emp_all$raise))
head(emp_all[, c("name", "rating", "raise", "new_salary")], 5)
```

E4:
```{r}
total <- sum(emp_all$new_salary)
if (total < 1600000) {
  print("Budget OK")
} else {
  print("Over budget")
}
print(total)
```

#PART F: Sorting and Ordering

F1:
```{r}
head(sort(emp_all$salary, decreasing = TRUE), 5)
head(sort(emp_all$name), 5)
```

F2:
```{r}
by_salary <- emp_all[order(emp_all$salary, decreasing = TRUE), ]
head(by_salary[, c("name", "department", "salary")], 5)
```
